Submission Description: (doc-less) Motion to Intervene of ON Energy Storage, Inc. under ER26-3685-000.

Dockets
-------
ER26-3685-000        Southwest Power Pool, Inc. submits tariff filing per 35.13(a)(2)(iii): Revisions to Clarify the Conditional High Impact Large Load Policy submitted on 9/2/2026 12:26:56 PM, Filing Type code: 10

Filing Party/Contacts:

Filing Party                             Signer (Representative)                  Other Contact (Principal)               
------------                             -----------------------                  -------------------------               
ON Energy Storage, Inc.                  lucas.fykes@on.energy                                                            

Basis for Intervening:
ON Energy Storage, Inc. (“ON.energy”) supplies and operates hyperscale power systems, including medium-voltage uninterruptible power supply technology designed to support the interconnection and reliable operation of large computational loads and data centers. SPP’s Conditional High Impact Large Load policy and the tariff provisions at issue in this proceeding may directly affect ON.energy’s commercial and technical interests, its customers, and the deployment of its technology. ON.energy therefore has an interest that may be directly affected by the outcome of this proceeding. ON.energy does not take a position on the merits of SPP’s filing at this time.
